text:
deploy-bot: Requested promotion: release/v2.4.1 -> prod. Canary window 30m. preflight-eval-id=eval-6543. status=HOLD (regression detected).
jin: Saw the hold. preflight summary shows summarizer prompt-suite B dropped -3.8% rouge-L vs v2.4.0. Not a catastrophic failure but above our threshold.
sara: I pulled the eval artifacts, running a quick sample. looks like longer inputs truncate differently after the new tokenizer change. reproducing locally now.
miguel: if tokenizer change is root cause we can pin model version for the summarizer route to v2.4.0 and promote the rest. is that acceptable?
sara: yeah pinning route /summarize to v2.4.0 would be fastest mitigation. we should also run the focused regression suite (50 prompts) on the canary before wider rollout.
qa-bot: Focused regression run (subset-50) started for release/v2.4.1 on canary. run-id=reg-2016-05.
jin: Proposed plan: 1) Pin /summarize -> v2.4.0; 2) Promote v2.4.1 to prod with 10% traffic for 60m; 3) Run focused regression; 4) Auto-rollback if rouge-L drops >2.5% or latency +30%. Approve?
miguel: +1 to plan. need runbook snippet for rollback UX.
sara: I will attach a small hotfix branch for tokenizer edge-case if we confirm. timeline ~3h from now.
darya: I'm ok with the staggered rollout as long as SLO guardrails and auto-rollback are in place. please include a comms note for CS if we hit the rollback.
jin: rollback runbook (snippet):
```
- trigger: auto-rollback condition met OR manual /releases rollback
- command: deploybot rollback release/v2.4.1 --to release/v2.4.0
- notify: #incidents, #customer-impact, oncall
- postmortem: create within 72h
```
deploy-bot: Canary started: release/v2.4.1 at 10% traffic. canary-id=canary-2016001. monitoring: rouge-L, latency-p50, error-rate. auto-rollback thresholds configured.
qa-bot: Focused regression (reg-2016-05) COMPLETE: 50 tests, 44 pass, 6 borderline (delta between -1.5% and -2.4% rouge-L). No catastrophic failures.
sara: borderline cases are all long-document summaries; consistent with tokenizer suspicion. i'll draft the hotfix and a targeted eval for those cases.
miguel: proceeding to promote other routes. pin applied: /summarize -> v2.4.0 (pinned by jin).
darya: approving canary > expand to 30% after 60m if metrics hold. please escalate immediately if auto-rollback fires. :thumbsup:
jin: thanks all. I'll update the release notes: note about tokenizer change + pinned route + follow-up hotfix. closing thread when expanded or rollback occurs.
